summary: Public sign-in route that emails a magic link to whatever address the caller gives, limited only per IP address.

expected_findings.explanation: POST /login needs no authentication and sends one email to the address in the request body, plus one KV write. The only bound is a Rate Limiting binding keyed by IP, which is per location and which a distributed client avoids; nothing in the code limits sends per address or in total. Email to an address the caller chooses is the reputational case: per 1M requests that is 1M emails, about $350 at $0.35 per 1,000 beyond the 3,000 included, and hard bounces to made-up addresses count and hurt the sending domain.
